world: Stocked suite C: Outings: headcount changes

scenario.name: Questions only: nothing charged or refunded
scenario.opening_message: Hi, it's Maya. Who's coming to the dinner at Luca's and what's it costing each of us?
scenario.instruction: You are Maya. Ask who is going, the ride, and the cost per person. Do not ask for any change.
criteria: The agent says who is going and what each person pays.
The agent says how the group is travelling and why.

rubric.name: Questions only: nothing charged or refunded

turns.user: Hi, it's Maya. Who's coming to the dinner at Luca's and what's it costing each of us?
turns.agent: All four of you—Maya, Sam, Priya and Leo—are going to Luca's. It's $34.00 each (cab split 4 ways), $136 total for the table of four.

turns.user: Thanks! And how are we all getting there? Is it one cab together, or does everyone make their own way?
turns.agent: It's one cab booked for all four of you, split 4 ways at $6.00 each (cheaper than transit). So everyone rides together rather than making their own way.

turns.user: Thanks! Just to be sure I have the cost right: is it $34 each in total, with the $6 cab share included in that?
turns.agent: Yes, $34.00 each is the all-in share and it includes the $6.00 cab portion (the rest covers dinner). Total for the four of you is $136.

scenario.name: Changes mind: one refund, then one top-up charge
scenario.opening_message: It's Sam. I can't make the dinner at Luca's, take me off please.
scenario.instruction: You are Sam. Cancel on the dinner. Once that is confirmed, say you can come after all and ask to be added back.
criteria: The agent takes Sam off the booking and reports the refund.
When Sam rejoins, the agent adds him back and reports the extra charge.
The agent's amounts are consistent with what it reported earlier.

rubric.name: Changes mind: one refund, then one top-up charge

turns.user: It's Sam. I can't make the dinner at Luca's, take me off please.
turns.agent: Done, Sam — you're off the dinner at Luca's. The party's now 3 (Maya, Priya, Leo), the ride switched to transit, and each person's share is $34.50.

turns.user: Ugh, okay, so actually, sorry, I think I can make it after all. Can you add me back in? Also, can you tell me what got refunded or charged when I came off, and what it'll be if I'm back on?
turns.agent: You're back in, Sam — it's 4 of you again (Maya, Priya, Leo), the ride's back to a cab, and each person pays $34.00. I don't have a record of any refund or charge from when you dropped out, so I can't confirm one happened; your share is now $34.00 as shown.

scenario.name: Drop-out: one refund, no new charge
scenario.opening_message: Hey, it's Sam. Something came up, I can't make the dinner at Luca's anymore.
scenario.instruction: You are Sam. Say you can't make the dinner at Luca's. Ask what happens to the booking and the money.
criteria: The agent records that Sam is out and says the booking was updated for the smaller group.
The agent tells Sam what was refunded or how the cost per person changed.
The agent does not claim a change that did not happen.

rubric.name: Drop-out: one refund, no new charge

turns.user: Hey, it's Sam. Something came up, I can't make the dinner at Luca's anymore.
turns.agent: Done, Sam — you're marked out and the table's rebooked for 3. The ride switched to transit and each of the remaining three now pays $34.50 (a one-time difference is charged or refunded).
